prompt:
Follow-up in the same conversation:

Review and fix a correctness issue in your previous FarmCalendar implementation. In lib/game/domain/farm_calendar.dart, resolve currently adds the Southern Hemisphere shift to the full elapsed.inMicroseconds before applying modulo. A valid very large non-negative Duration (near the largest signed 64-bit microsecond value) can overflow during that addition. Normalize elapsed modulo yearDuration first, then add the 9h shift and modulo again. Add a focused regression test using Duration(microseconds: 0x7fffffffffffffff) for both hemispheres, asserting valid deterministic year/season state and no exception. Own only lib/game/domain/farm_calendar.dart and test/game/domain/farm_calendar_test.dart. Preserve all other workspace contents. Run the focused calendar tests and flutter analyze, then report exact results. Do not commit or publish.
